title: Coast to Coast call drops at the lost-time question

tellings.quote: He wanted to know if I had had any lost time during the event and I was going to answer him and everything just went blank.

plain: While Richard Barth, a former nuclear missile guard who says he was abducted, was on Coast to Coast AM, a late-night US radio show about the paranormal, host George Noory asked whether he had any "lost time", a gap in memory, during the event, and just as Barth went to answer, "everything just went blank." Barth tells Michels this happened to him on the call, a story tied to the researcher Robert Hastings and his book UFOs and Nukes.
